_about: Dependency versions allowed in although they were published less than 14 days ago.
An entry is only for a version that fixes a real, known vulnerability, and only after
checking that (1) no older version is free of it and (2) the package cannot be dropped or
replaced without losing something the app needs. Say so in 'reason'.
check-dependency-age.ps1 fails the build once an entry's version is 14 days old (it is no
longer an exception: delete the entry) or is no longer used at all.

exceptions.reason: Every version from 0.3.2 has the vulnerability until 1.51.6 and 1.53.3, both published 2026-10-13, and Tauri runs on tokio, so it cannot be dropped or replaced. 1.53.3 is the smallest step from the 1.53.1 we had.
